_comment: Twenty golden prompts. Each is scored on four checks; a case passes only if all four do. Keep this file stable - the whole point is comparing runs against the SAME prompts as the system changes. Five cases carry a followup: a small change requested on the app just built, run in the same project. Follow-ups are reported separately (did the build still pass; did the agent edit or rewrite) so the pass rate stays comparable with runs from before they existed.

cases.prompt: A recipe page with three recipe cards, each showing a name, ingredients and prep time.
A tip calculator: enter a bill amount and a tip percentage, show the tip and the total.
cases.followup: Make the Calculate button green with rounded corners.

cases.prompt: A countdown timer to New Year's Day that updates every second.
cases.followup: Change the main heading to say 'Almost there!'.

cases.prompt: A to-do list where I can type a task, add it, and tick it off.
A one-page portfolio site with a header, an about section and three project cards.
A pricing page with three plans side by side and a highlighted middle plan.
cases.followup: Give the highlighted middle plan a gold border.

cases.prompt: A contact form with name, email and message fields, and client-side validation.
A unit converter between celsius and fahrenheit that converts as you type.
An FAQ page with five questions that expand and collapse when clicked.
cases.followup: Make the page background light grey.

cases.prompt: A photo gallery grid with six placeholder tiles and captions.
A dice roller that shows a random number from one to six when you press a button.
A page that shows a random quote from a built-in list, with a button for a new one.
A restaurant menu page with starters, mains and desserts as three sections.
A stopwatch with start, stop and reset buttons showing minutes, seconds and hundredths.
cases.followup: Make the time display twice as large.

cases.prompt: A colour picker that changes the page background to the chosen colour and shows its hex.
A product landing page with a hero headline, three feature blocks and a call to action.
A textarea that counts words and characters live as you type.
A blog index page listing four posts with titles, dates and short excerpts.
A password generator with a length slider and a copy button.
A conference schedule page with a table of times, talks and speakers.
